# MIDI Metadata

## Summary
The structure of a MIDI sequence: timing, tracks, notes and the programs used.

## Shape
A MIDI file is instructions rather than samples, so there is no waveform here and no codec —
what matters is `format` (0, 1 or 2), `ppq` (pulses per quarter note) and the derived
`durationSeconds`. `tempoMap`, `timeSignatures` and `keySignatures` are string lists because a
sequence can change all three mid-piece. `fileTrackCount` and `trackCount` differ when the file
declares more tracks in its header than actually carry events.

## Example
```ts
import { MidiMetadataField } from 'https://cardstack.com/base/file-formats/metadata-fields';

@field metadata = contains(MidiMetadataField);
```
